description: This script automates flashing, rebooting, and testing Android devices via adb and fastboot. It manages device preparation, flashing system and radio images, and running monkey tests in a loop.

methods.name: log_print
methods.description: Prints a timestamped message to the console.

methods.name: wait_for_battery
methods.description: Blocks until the device's battery level reaches at least 80%.

methods.name: fastboot_wait_for_device
methods.description: Waits until the device appears in fastboot mode, or times out.

methods.name: reboot_into_fastboot_from_adb
methods.description: Reboots device into fastboot mode from adb.

methods.name: reboot_into_fastboot_from_fastboot
methods.description: Reboots device into fastboot mode from fastboot.

methods.name: reboot_into_adb_from_fastboot
methods.description: Reboots device from fastboot to adb.

methods.name: wait_for_boot_complete
methods.description: Waits until the device finishes booting.

methods.name: fastboot_command
methods.description: Wraps the fastboot command with device and sleep.

methods.name: flash_bootloader_image
methods.description: Flashes the bootloader image to the device.

methods.name: flash_radio_image
methods.description: Flashes the radio image to the device.

methods.name: flash_system_image
methods.description: Downloads and flashes the system image.

methods.name: flash_device
methods.description: Performs full device flashing sequence including cache erase and images flashing.

methods.name: set_product_type
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the device product ID.
